# Card Resource

## Contract
The wire shape of a card instance — a JSON:API resource:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "type": "card",
    "attributes": { "…field values…": "…" },
    "relationships": { "…linksTo fields…": {} },
    "meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "…", "name": "…" } }
  }
}
```

Invariants:
- `type` is always `"card"`.
- Contained field values live in `attributes`; linked cards ONLY in
  `relationships`.
- `meta.adoptsFrom` is required and must resolve (see Adopts From Metadata).
- Realms re-serialize on save: UTF-8 (no unicode escapes), no trailing
  newline — byte-identical round-trips are not guaranteed, semantic
  round-trips are.

## Captured example
`Account/acme-industries.json` in this realm: attributes carry
name/email/billingAddress…, meta.adoptsFrom points at `../account`.

## Source
Shape: `runtime-common/card-document-shape.ts`. Serialization entry point
in base: `https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` (`serializeForUI`).
